after.description: Return messages after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. "2026-03-01T12:00:00.000Z") for incremental sync

before.description: Return messages before this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. "2026-03-01T12:00:00.000Z") for cursor-based pagination backward

community.description: Filter conversations by community name or ID

entity.description: Entity type to query. Defaults to "conversations" when listing, or all when searching. Use "session" to list all connected WhatsApp accounts.

exclude_archived.description: Exclude archived conversations from listings (default true)

exclude_muted.description: Exclude muted conversations from listings (default false)

group.description: Filter contacts by group ID — only return contacts that are members of this group

id.description: Look up a specific conversation, contact, or label by ID

include_participants.description: Include group participants in results. Useful when looking up a contact by ID to see which groups they belong to, or when querying a group to see its members.

label.description: Filter conversations by label name or ID (Business accounts)

list.description: Filter conversations by list name or ID (Personal accounts)

query.description: Text to search for (names, messages, transcriptions)

target_session.description: Session ID to target a specific WhatsApp account. Get session IDs from entity="session". If omitted, routes to the most recently active account.

unread.description: Only return conversations with unread messages

name: query
